title: Thousands gather in Paris suburbs to remember racist attack victims

tea.why: Thousands gathered in Trappes and La Verrière to remember the victims of a recent racist shooting targeting Muslims and Africans.
tea.want: To stand together against racism and Islamophobia.
tea.changed: Oct 30: Thousands gathered for a memorial rally in Trappes and La Verrière, which ended with the French national anthem.

summary: Thousands of people gathered in the Paris suburbs of Trappes and La Verrière to remember the victims of a shooting that occurred on the previous Friday. According to reports, a gunman had targeted Muslims and people of African and North African descent in an attack that left one person dead and seven others injured. The local non-governmental organisation 'Aider' helped coordinate the gathering. During the memorial event, the mayor of Trappes, Ali Rabeh, criticised the normalisation of hatred, while President Emmanuel Macron condemned the incident as a racist terrorist attack and accused right-wing political elements of fostering a climate of racism.
response: President Emmanuel Macron condemned the incident as a racist terrorist attack. Authorities confirmed that the suspect was arrested and is facing murder and attempted murder charges with terrorist and racist components.

updates.text: Thousands gathered in Trappes and La Verrière to remember the victims of the racist shooting attack.
